shots.title: V01 · First-run setup
shots.caption: First run: no accounts exist, so the sign-in page asks for the administrator. Passwords are hashed with scrypt on the server; the browser never stores them.
marks: Password (8+, not on the common list, not your name)

shots.title: V02 · Case files desk
shots.caption: The case-files desk after sign-in: every case the account may see as a folder, drawers by review state, the morning brief, filters, quick add, OSINT, and the admin's Users button. Everything shown comes from the server.
marks: Case folder (open, flip, rename, tag, duplicate, export, archive, public)

shots.title: V03 · Users and access
shots.caption: Users & access: accounts with role, TLP:RED grant and case scope, password reset (the user must choose a new one at next sign-in), removal, and the sign-in audit from the server. New users get a temporary password that unlocks nothing but the password change.
marks: Analyst: edits the cases in scope

shots.title: V04 · Analyst view
shots.caption: The analyst's desk: same cases (scope "all"), no Users button, their own name in the top bar.

shots.title: V05 · Board, modes and the worked example
shots.caption: The board in Homicide mode with the built-in worked example (Whitechapel, 1888): modes change the card vocabulary, suspect roles and the suspect matrix. Case changes made here are pushed to the server and appear on every other signed-in board.

shots.title: V06 · Geo view
shots.caption: Geo (G): location cards are placed on a map; OpenStreetMap tiles load directly, geocoding goes through the server proxy.

shots.title: V07 · Suspect matrix
shots.caption: Suspect matrix: every person card marked as a suspect scored on means, motive, opportunity and alibi.

shots.title: V08 · AI gateway (local engine)
shots.caption: "Analyse with Claude" without an API key: the server's built-in engine answers in the same JSON shape (summary, suggested stamp, suggested threads, next steps) and labels itself as rule-based. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to use the model instead.

shots.title: V09 · Settings
shots.caption: Settings: theme, atmosphere (sounds, rain, typewriter), SIEM deep-link templates and other preferences, saved per user on the server.

shots.title: V10 · Viewer
shots.caption: A viewer's desk: the same folders, read-only; the server rejects any write from this role.

shots.title: V11 · Guest
shots.caption: Guest access: when a case is marked public (TLP:CLEAR or GREEN only), the sign-in page offers "Continue as a guest" and the desk shows just that case, read-only.

shots.title: V12 · Lockout
shots.caption: Brute-force protection: after ten failures the account is locked for 15 minutes even with the right password, sign-ins are rate-limited per IP, and every attempt is in the audit log. An admin reset clears the lock.

shots.title: V13 · Sign in
shots.caption: Sign-in page once accounts exist. Sessions last 12 hours and lock after 15 minutes idle.
